What to look for: in both DXC panes, the disassembled function body for
`MyHSMainPassthrough` contains four `call float @dx.op.loadInput.f32(...)`
lines (one per float component of `POSITION`), and `!dx.entryPoints` names a
real function pointer (`void ()* @MyHSMainPassthrough`), not `null`. That is
the reported bug: SM5's control-point pass-through case (control point body
is just `return input[id];`) is not recognized, so DXC still emits a normal
control-point shader that manually copies every component instead of eliding
the control-point invocation entirely.
